text: It is not the size of the army in the fight, but the size of the fight in the army.
author: Alexander the Great

text: The supreme art of war is to subdue the enemy without fighting.
author: Sun Tzu

text: If you want peace, prepare for war.
author: Publius Flavius Vegetius Renatus

text: Cowards die many times before their deaths; the valiant never taste of death but once.
author: William Shakespeare

text: In war, truth is the first casualty.
author: Aeschylus

text: Know yourself and know your enemy.
author: Sun Tzu

text: He who sweats more in training bleeds less in war.
author: Spartan Proverb

text: An army marches on its stomach.
author: Napoleon Bonaparte

text: Impossible is a word to be found only in the dictionary of fools.
author: Napoleon Bonaparte

text: Victorious warriors win first and then go to war.
author: Sun Tzu

text: No plan survives first contact with the enemy.
author: Helmuth von Moltke the Elder

text: The more you know, the less you fear.
author: Alexander Suvorov

text: Discipline is the soul of an army.
author: George Washington
